candidates.rationale: The wall of Jerusalem is completed after 52 days of intense work, causing joy among the people and awe among their enemies.
Jesus declares to the Father that He has glorified Him by finishing the work He was given to do, expressing the satisfaction of completing His mission.
Paul expresses genuine satisfaction at the end of his life, having finished the race and kept the faith.
The Israelites complete all the work on the tabernacle exactly as commanded, and Moses sees it finished and blesses them.
Solomon finishes his prayer of dedication for the newly completed temple and stands to bless the assembly with joy over the finished house of God.
